git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Multi-iteration drift; recent auto-commits 4e90833 / c74b6a4 / 0231e17 / 99e1c7a / 3e08398 are cumulative iterations that each broke one side of the data↔renderer contract
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Each prior cycle changed ONE side (data shape OR renderer logic) without verifying the other side; the renderer treats data fields literally and never warned when fields were unused or misrouted
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Co-evolved data + renderer in a single cycle. Each bug got both a data-side fix AND a renderer-side fix verified end-to-end via deployed PLAN_DATA inspection.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: All edits are surgical per the BA spec (no refactors, no helpers). The 121 lines = renderer guard logic (5 fix sites) + 17 image cache aliases + Wudaokou meal placeholders for 9 slots + Day 9-11 stale-data removal + skeleton normalisation. The Wudaokou meal placeholders alone are ~80 lines because each meal is a fully-populated dict with name/location/cuisine/cost/notes/image bilingual fields — required by the schema.
